summary: Five9, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing the commencement of an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with JPMorgan Chase to repurchase $90.0 million of its common stock under an existing authorization. The company will make a $90 million payment on May 5, 2026, and expects an initial delivery of ~3.1 million shares. The final repurchase price will be based on the VWAP over the term, less a discount. Settlement is expected by September 30, 2026. This is a capital return to shareholders; watch for VWAP performance and final share count delivery.
